hazard: Unrestricted sale of helium gas canisters

concerns.quote: The sale of Helium gas canisters is readily available to members of the general 1 public with no apparent restrictions or conditions on sale or place.
concerns.hazard: unrestricted sale of helium gas canisters

concerns.quote: Helium canisters are not fitted with any modified control valve which if in place could restrict the volume of gas being released and are generally sold in standard sizes.
concerns.hazard: lack of safety valve on helium canisters

concerns.quote: The type of immediate and easily accessible information through internet search engines which provides clear and detailed guidance on how to commit suicide by inhalation of helium gas.
concerns.hazard: online suicide instructions for helium inhalation

concerns.quote: The latest statistical update on Suicide report issued in January 2014 by the Department for Health suggests that there were 51 deaths mentioning helium in 2012 in England, almost five times higher than the 11 deaths recorded in 2008. Although the number of deaths involving these substances is still relatively small, the large increases are of particular interest as almost all of these deaths were suicides.

concerns.quote: I have concerns as to whether the safety information on these gas cannisters is clear and sufficient
concerns.hazard: insufficient safety information on gas cannisters

concerns.quote: Separate consideration needs to be given to the labelling and colouring of gas cylinders to enable emergency services to respond to any risk arising at an incident
concerns.hazard: lack of colour coding on gas cylinders

links.explanation: Both reports highlight that helium gas canisters can be bought by the public without any purchase restrictions. They note the lack of controls on sale and the associated suicide risk.
